title: Theater of Masks
description: A surreal night scene depicts a woman in a blue floral dress and white mask holding a smartphone, facing a hooded figure in a black hoodie marked #F238 who holds a burning film reel. They stand beside a moonlit pool with a projector screen and empty theater seats floating in the dark sky amid smoke, flowers, and scattered theatrical masks.
prompt: Surreal night scene with a woman in a blue floral dress and comedy mask holding a glowing smartphone, standing opposite a hooded figure in a black hoodie with #F238 on the back, holding a burning film reel.
